verdict.rationale: First-party docs state Appwrite was designed for self-hosting and runs on any OS with a Docker CLI. They also document one-click marketplace deployments, full control over data location, and migrations between Cloud and self-hosted. A community user independently praises the self-hosting guide, and the CLI supports self-hosted endpoints. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence on the depth of feature parity between self-hosted and Cloud (e.g., the dedicated PostgreSQL and compute tiers appear Cloud-oriented).
